children: BioVie entered into a sales agreement to establish an at-the-market (ATM) equity program of up to $6,464,341 in Class A common stock for general corporate purposes. Shares may be sold from time to time through A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners on The Nasdaq Capital Market or other U.S. trading venues, or via negotiated transactions. The company will pay a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds to the agent. The ATM is expected to provide flexible access to capital as needed.
